tagline: Your mouse, your keys, every time it reconnects
brief: A menu-bar app for macOS that replaces BetterMouse and Karabiner for one person's setup: MX Master buttons over HID++, a hyper key on Caps Lock, smooth scrolling with a tuned curve, and every setting re-applied the moment a device reconnects. It should feel precise, quiet and a little cheeky, not like another blue system-utility gear.
criteria: Success: reads as a rat (the mouse pun) at a glance, survives as an 18 pt menu-bar template icon, works in one colour, and stays clear of Mickey-style round-ear mascots.

concepts.name: Ratchet rat
concepts.idea: Ratchet, rat, mouse: a rat's face built from one long wedge, two ears and two eyes.
rationale: The pun does the explaining: a mouse utility named after a rat
Long snout and small ears keep it rat, not Mickey
Pink ears are the one colour accent; everything else is ink
Small cut with bigger eyes holds up in the 18 pt menu bar

recommendation: Ratchet rat as the symbol, menu-bar icon and app icon, with the Inter Display wordmark.
next_steps: Trademark and App Store name search for Ratchet
Drop AppIcon.icns and the menu-bar template into the app
Optional: custom-draw one letter of the wordmark for ownership
